name: HijackLibs (DLL hijacking candidates)
tier_rationale: Community project with a public repository, documentation and an open licence (published since 2022): A8 community. Offline use only (disclosure none: tier n/a).

reliability.justification: Curated list of DLLs vulnerable to side-loading/search-order hijacking with the affected executables; DLL names collide across vendors, so name matches are low-confidence context (P268 cond 5).

dataset.title: HijackLibs api/hijacklibs.json (DLL names, vendors, vulnerable executables, hijack types, CVEs)

terms.quote: GNU GENERAL PUBLIC LICENSE Version 3, 29 June 2007 (LICENSE of wietze/HijackLibs, verified 2026-11-26): GPL-3.0 data, downloaded at runtime only and never bundled (A6).

dataset.notes: https://hijacklibs.net/api/hijacklibs.json (983 KB, 628 entries on 2026-11-26). Runtime download only (GPL-3.0, P268 cond 2). The GitHub Pages 404 body starts with '<style': validated as JSON before it replaces a copy.
